trust.title: Built for buyers who order by the container

items.title: Origin-direct sourcing
items.body: We buy directly at the growing regions, cutting out layers of resale so your landed cost stays competitive.

items.title: Sampled, graded lots
items.body: Every shipment is sampled and graded before it ships, so what you approve is what arrives.

items.title: Export-ready packing
items.body: Bulk bags, cartons, or vacuum packaging built for ocean freight, with full export documentation.

items.title: Flexible MOQs & Incoterms
items.body: From trial pallets to full containers, quoted FOB, CFR, or CIF to suit how you buy.

ctaBand.title: Sourcing for a season, or standing supply?
ctaBand.body: Tell us the product, grade, and volume you need — we'll come back with a firm quote and lead time.

products.heading: The range
products.subheading: Five crops, graded to industry standard and packed to order.

almonds.name: Almonds
almonds.description: Bulk almonds sourced from Iran's Mamra orchards and California's premium groves, sorted for consistent size and moisture, ready for confectionery, snacking, or nut-milk production.

pistachios.name: Pistachios
pistachios.description: Iranian pistachios from the growing belts of Kerman and Rafsanjan, offered raw or roasted, in-shell or kernel, at the size grade your production line needs.

pine-nuts.name: Pine Nuts
pine-nuts.description: Wild-harvested chilgoza pine nuts and cultivated Chinese pine nuts, hand-cracked and vacuum packed to protect their delicate oils in transit.

dried-figs.name: Dried Figs
dried-figs.description: Naturally sun-dried figs from Estahban, Iran and the Aydin valley in Turkey, offered whole, layer-packed, or as a paste base for bakery and health-food production.

saffron.name: Saffron
saffron.description: Khorasan saffron, hand-picked and dried within hours of harvest, graded to ISO 3632 for color, flavor, and aroma strength — from bulk threads to retail-ready packaging.

about.title: A direct line to origin
about.intro: Seraj Store is a bulk supplier of premium dried nuts, dried fruit, and saffron, built to serve importers, retailers, manufacturers, and HORECA buyers who need consistent quality at volume.
about.body: We work directly with growers and packing houses across Iran, Central Asia, Türkiye, and the United States, sampling and grading every lot before it ships. Whether you're placing a trial order or setting up standing supply, we quote transparently and document every shipment for smooth customs clearance at your end.
